tuned_against: UNTUNED - placeholder values, not yet fitted to real footage
notes: This file is the handoff artifact between the Python prototype and the Kotlin build.
The Kotlin app loads it verbatim. Do not retype these numbers into either codebase.
Every value below is a placeholder until CP 5/CP 6 tuning against real recorded reps.
TRD.md 5 is explicit that the hip-drive threshold is the one number in this system
with no literature behind it. Treat these as starting points, not findings.

phase._doc: Knee angle in degrees, hip-knee-ankle. Seated is roughly 90, standing roughly 175.

observation._doc: Landmark visibility is the raw measurement; these turn it into a quality judgement.
observation._doc_tolerance: How much of the RISE may be unobservable before the rep is INVALID.

strategy._doc: StrategySignal is 0.0 fully knee-dominant, 1.0 fully hip-dominant.
strategy._doc_ratio: Computed from delta-hip-angle vs delta-knee-angle across the rise window.
strategy._doc_windows: Separate windows: the trigger must be fast, the meter must look steady.

descent._doc: Eccentric control. Higher is smoother; a collapsing descent scores low.

cue._doc: Fixed phrases, keyed by which threshold fired. Never generated at runtime.
cue._doc_latency: keypoints -> signal -> playback start should stay under 200ms (TRD 5a).

policy._doc: Deterministic lock rules. No AI touches any value in this block.
policy._doc_gap: Max days between sessions for a swelling comparison to be valid.
policy._doc_gap_2: Beyond this the prior session is not 'yesterday' and the status
policy._doc_gap_3: becomes NO_COMPARISON rather than a silent compare across the gap.
policy._doc_copy: Calm and specific, never alarming (PRD 8). Salvaged from FEATURES.md 4.

copy.allow_full: Everything is on the plan today.
copy.rest_only: Today is a rest day. Gentle movement only.
copy.hold: We could not see enough today to add loaded work.

capture._doc: The raw frame handed to the pose model is NEVER mirrored (CP 3).
capture._doc_why: Mirroring swaps the model's LEFT/RIGHT labels, so the operated-side lock
capture._doc_why_2: would silently point at the healthy leg. Flip for display only.

explain._doc: Local LLM phrasing. It receives a finished LockDecision and cannot alter it.
